title: The prairie's planting grid now has a graphics-card version
items: Nothing you can see changed. The grid that decides where each grass tuft, flower and shrub stands now has a graphics-card version, ready for the near grass to be drawn without the phone's processor laying it out at every step.
Read back from the browser at every scene anchor, it puts all 373,710 test plants exactly where the current code does, within a twentieth of a millimetre.
